title: How to add a bill
subject: Re: {original_subject}
body:
Hi{from_name_greeting},

Thanks for asking about adding a bill.

In Ben you can add a bill by taking a photo, choosing a PDF from Files, or forwarding a bill email to your personal Ben address (you will find that address in Settings → Email in).

After Ben reads the bill, you will see the details on screen to check before anything is saved. Nothing is stored until you confirm.

If a particular bill is not reading correctly, reply with what you tried (photo, PDF, or email) and we can help.

Kind regards,
Ben support
